h1_support_split.method: Deterministic keyword classification of each H1-supporting claim's verbatim quotes into pre-purchase uncertainty vs post-purchase grievance. A claim with both signals, or neither, is 'unclear' — never forced. Fully reproducible (reclassify_h1.py, no API key).
h1_support_split.summary: Of 125 H1-supporting claims, post-purchase grievance is the larger bucket — 77 (62%) vs 8 pre-purchase (6%), 40 unclear. Computed from the verbatim quotes, this means the corpus's H1 lean (net +118) is largely NOT about pre-purchase hesitation on saved items; it is dominated by complaints about returns/delivery on completed purchases. That is the data-scale echo of the 6 interviews: H1 is not the primary saved-item→purchase blocker.
